original: 데이터 초기화에 실패해도 업데이트는 독립적으로 되도록 수정하고 검증해서 배포해줘. 지금 내 PC 설치본은 그 기능을 직접 테스트할거니까 업데이트하지 말고.
requirements: Update discovery independent of SQLite/settings/startup success
Signed installer/portable update after terminal failure without AppState
Refuse installation during initialization/cancellation or active/unknown work
Manual retry in startup failure; no tutorial obstruction
Publish verified signed release, then update host via normal installer only when no active app work; preserve settings/media/database
acceptance: Native IPC failure without AppState, reserve/release/retry, non-main denial, startup/active-work exclusion
Frontend failure UI and failed download release
Actual isolated desktop failure update check/download/signature path

limits: Already installed older versions retain old updater code until separately upgraded
Computer Use was stopped with physical Escape after the actual isolated error/retry screen was observed; user confirmed the test. Remaining host checks used read-only native diagnostics.

verification.hostStartup: backend_ready 1669ms; settings_ready 351ms; interactive_frame 1985ms; recordings_ready 3658ms; no ERROR events; native responsive

verification.signedPackage: Installer and portable Ed25519 signatures; tamper rejection; all 13 changed packaged sources and 233 portable entries verified; native production-signed archive extraction/tamper test passed.
